other_failure_modes.name: Target Encoding Leakage in CV
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes out-of-fold target encoding features globally before the main CV loop and uses the exact same StratifiedKFold configuration (same splits and random seed) for both. This causes target leakage, because a row's target encoding feature in the training folds was computed using the target values of the validation fold.

other_failure_modes.name: Imputation and Text Extraction before CV Splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits the SimpleImputer, TfidfVectorizer, and TruncatedSVD on the entire training dataset before the cross-validation loop. This causes a minor data leakage where validation distribution statistics leak into the training folds.

summary: The agent submitted a highly robust and sophisticated data science solution, effectively utilizing feature engineering, deep learning, and gradient boosting within a proper cross-validation framework. The primary flaw is a subtle target leakage issue caused by reusing the exact same cross-validation splits for global out-of-fold target encoding and the main training loop, which allows models to implicitly 'see' validation targets during training. Additionally, imputation and text vectorization are fit globally on the training set before CV splitting, causing minor validation distribution leakage.
